description: List cities DICE (dice.fm) sells event tickets in, worldwide. Optionally filter by name/country substring. Each city's `id` + `perm_name` is what dice_browse needs. Use this first to resolve a city name to a browse id.

query.description: Optional substring to filter by city name, perm_name, or country name (case-insensitive), e.g. "york", "united kingdom".

name: dice_cities
title: Dice Cities
